query: SELECT min(at) FROM (SELECT min(e.sent_at) AS at FROM contact_email e JOIN mentor m ON m.id=e.mentor_id WHERE m.trashed_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT min(msg.sent_at) FROM contact_message msg JOIN message_mentor mm ON mm.message_id=msg.id JOIN mentor m ON m.id=mm.mentor_id WHERE m.trashed_at IS NULL)
